title: Workshop Apprentice
subtitle: At the Sculptor's Bench
bodyText: A workshop apprentice prepares clay, tends tools, and watches experienced hands shape a figure. Familiarity with the material slowly becomes judgment, laying the humble foundation from which convincing bronze can rise.
sceneBrief: A simply dressed workshop apprentice prepares clay or wax at a low bench, bronze casting workshop behind, no master portrait pose.
